title: Qualcomm is raising phone chip prices starting September 1st
summary: ﻿Qualcomm reported its lowest quarterly handset revenue since 2021. ﻿Qualcomm reported its lowest quarterly handset revenue since 2021. Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon said on Wednesday that “prices are going to go up” on the company’s products starting on September 1st, CNBC reports.
